manifest.scientific_status: See uncertainty gates; workflow completion does not certify convergence
manifest.scope: Weak errors for stopped native DK at fixed grid; no continuum convergence claim

interpretation.scope: Stopped spatially discrete DK at the manifest grid and particle count
interpretation.normalization: Analytic uniform-IID histogram fluctuation units; sqrt(N) means, N covariances
interpretation.seeds: Each fitted optimizer seed is reported separately; no method or seed averaging
interpretation.intervals: Pointwise whole-family bootstrap 95% intervals, not simultaneous bands
interpretation.certification: Existing accuracy gates are copied; RMSE alone never creates certification
interpretation.reference: Finite reference refinements do not certify remaining continuous-time bias
interpretation.cost: Shared generation/training and standalone timings repeat across rows; do not sum repeats
interpretation.stopping: All stopped paths retained; zero-event upper bound is one-sided exact binomial at 95%
interpretation.wasserstein: Descriptive empirical distances without bootstrap uncertainty

uniform.reason: A finite half/quarter refinement difference, even with paired Monte Carlo intervals, does not bound the remaining bias to the continuous-time stopped discrete DK law. No convergence order or asymptotic extrapolation is assumed.
